instagram.caption:
Books you keep to be the person who read them.
The Bookshelves and Display in the Living Room. Hold the books you will genuinely open again, and a small number of objects you actually want to look at.

What done looks like:
1. Each shelf has a hand's width of empty space at one end
2. Books standing upright between bookends with nothing stacked flat on top of them
3. Objects gathered in two or three groups instead of spaced evenly along every shelf
4. A strap running from the top of the unit into the wall

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success bookshelves and display.
